dispatch_allowance.note: a lost response is still a send; the guard counts it and so does this

internal_held_units.note: all reservations settled; nothing left held

lost_responses.note: receipts with outcome=failure and no token usage; the provider may or may not have answered and billed.

provider_billing.note: every settled gateway receipt carries billed=null and charge_units=null, so the token counts are known and the charge is not. This is not zero.

supersedes: cost.json labels provider_billing NOT_REPORTED with the recording-double reason, which is the wrong label for a live run. The four measured numbers are here.
